fact: Captain Errde Blackskull is the patron of the party and a member of the Stone Guard.
source_quote: Their patron, Captain Errde Blackskull of the Stone Guard
subject: Captain Errde Blackskull

fact: The Stone Guard is the organization to which Captain Errde Blackskull belongs.
source_quote: Captain Errde Blackskull of the Stone Guard
subject: Stone Guard

fact: Gracklstugh is a city where Captain Errde Blackskull asked the party to investigate a disturbing rumor.
source_quote: asked them to look into a disturbing rumor circulating through the city of Gracklstugh
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: Grimholl Forgebrand is introduced by Errde as her subordinate and a resource for the party.
source_quote: She introduced her subordinate, Grimholl Forgebrand
subject: Grimholl Forgebrand

fact: Grimholl describes finding bodies with no visible wounds, such as sword cuts or burns.
source_quote: Grimholl Forgebrand, who described finding bodies with no visible wounds: no sword cuts, no burns, no magical residue
subject: Grimholl Forgebrand

fact: Grimholl reports that the clerics stated the victims could not be revived.
source_quote: Grimholl reports that the clerics said the victims couldn't be revived
subject: Grimholl Forgebrand

fact: Grimholl believes psionic assassins are responsible for the deaths.
source_quote: leading him to believe psionic assassins are responsible
subject: Grimholl Forgebrand

fact: Grimholl states that the killers use their minds to cast invisible blades.
source_quote: He adds that the killers use "their mind to cast these blades that would kill you... Nobody could ever see the blades, but you die."
subject: Grimholl Forgebrand

fact: Errde rolls her eyes in response to Grimholl's explanation of the psionic blades.
source_quote: Errde's eyes roll
subject: Errde rolling eyes

fact: Errde gropes for the right managerial word when calling Grimholl a resource.
source_quote: Errde calls him in as one of her "resources", after groping for the right managerial word for her subordinates
subject: Errde groping for word

fact: The Empty-Scabbard Killers are a supposed order of psionic assassins.
source_quote: a supposed order of psionic assassins known as the Empty-Scabbard Killers
subject: Empty-Scabbard Killers

fact: Forak-Erach-Naek is an alternative name for the Empty-Scabbard Killers.
source_quote: known as the Empty-Scabbard Killers or the Forak-Erach-Naek
subject: Forak-Erach-Naek

fact: The name Forak-Erach-Naek is derived from an ancient, obscure dwarvish dialect.
source_quote: their name derived from an ancient, obscure dwarvish dialect
subject: Forak-Erach-Naek

fact: The Forak-Erach-Naek are said to practice disciplines unknown to derro or priests.
source_quote: They are said to practice "disciplines unknown even to the savviest of derro or the wisest priest."
subject: Forak-Erach-Naek

fact: Errde views the Forak-Erach-Naek as a story used to keep children quiet.
source_quote: a story that old women and men tell their grandchildren to keep them quiet at night
subject: Forak-Erach-Naek

fact: Thorin wonders aloud if he should have chosen the Psi Warrior subclass over Battle Master.
source_quote: Thorin wonders aloud whether he should have picked Psi Warrior over Battle Master
subject: Thorin

fact: Daz makes a quip about 'those blades' being used alongside a dagger.
source_quote: Daz quips about "those blades" being used alongside a dagger "so I've heard."
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum asks who discovered the body that Errde's clan lost.
source_quote: When Gyrgum asks who discovered the body
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Errde personally found one of the bodies of the victims.
source_quote: she herself had found one of the bodies
subject: Errde finding body

fact: Errde snaps at Gyrgum, asserting that she was the one who found the dead body.
source_quote: it was I who found the dead body. Is there some kind of implication you're making?
subject: Errde finding body

fact: The Whorlstone Tunnels are an extensive network beneath Gracklstugh.
source_quote: pointed the party toward the Whorlstone Tunnels beneath Gracklstugh
subject: Whorlstone Tunnels

fact: The Whorlstone Tunnels are rumored to be a hiding place for the killers or those responsible.
source_quote: as a possible hiding place for whoever, or whatever, was responsible
subject: Whorlstone Tunnels

fact: Two members of Errde's clan have died under mysterious circumstances.
source_quote: two members of her own clan had died under these same mysterious circumstances
subject: death of two clan members

fact: The victim died in his own household while in the prime of his health.
source_quote: The victim was in the prime of his health and died in his own household
subject: victim death

fact: Errde's clan had all eaten the same food prior to the victim's death.
source_quote: the clan had all eaten the same food
subject: clan meal

source_quote: finding bodies with no visible wounds: no sword cuts, no burns, no magical residue

fact: No body is currently available for the party to examine.
